name: alternative-sections
title: Alternative page sections
description: Cost card, comparison tables, request costs, pricing, fit guide and related links for compare pages.
usage: Compare pages ("The top X alternative"). Order - Hero with AlternativeCostCard in HeroMedia, LogoStrip, AlternativeReasons, AlternativeRequestCosts, AlternativeComparisonTable, AlternativePricingTable, AlternativeFitGuide, ProductFaq (product-landing), AlternativeRelated, ClosingCta. AlternativeQuickCompare is deprecated (the site's hero now shows the cost card).
avoid: Red crosses for a missing feature (a faint dash)
Medium or bold weights in the tables (our side is told apart by color)
Claims without a source in the footnotes

reference.source: src/components/sections/alternatives/compare-page/compare-page.tsx; compare-cost-card.tsx; compare-request-costs.tsx; compare-pricing-table.tsx; compare-fit-guide.tsx; compare-related.tsx; compare-card.tsx; src/components/sections/alternatives/alternative-reasons.tsx; alternative-comparison-table.tsx; src/app/(marketing)/compare/the-top-firecrawl-alternative/page.tsx
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
